claude.reason: The base gave back 0.69 of the prior leg — more than twice the 0.34 threshold — meaning the consolidation is really a deep retracement, not a tight pause; the shaded box on the chart confirms a wide, declining range from ~181 down to ~167 with overlapping red and green bars throughout. The burst bar itself is half the width of recent bars (RE FAIL, vs_prior_5=0.5) and volume came in at only 64% of the prior session (VOL FAIL), so there is no expansion of either range or participation to confirm a genuine breakout. Three independent measured failures (C, RE, VOL) with no offsetting visual strength make this a skip.
claude.key_risk: The base is a downtrend with a bounce, not a consolidation; any continuation of the prior decline would immediately undercut the entry.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the burst close of 169.03 or if the first 30 minutes show no buying interest above 169.
